rejectedForRevision.Backpedal_Blender_v1.glb: Walk backward upright from approved idle, no hit/crouch pose.
rejectedForRevision.GuardTwoHand_Blender_v1.glb: Show idle-to-guard preparation, not instant defensive hold.
rejectedForRevision.StrafeLeft_Blender_v1.glb: Target-facing sidestep with separated feet, no crossed legs or bent torso.
rejectedForRevision.StrafeRight_Blender_v1.glb: Target-facing sidestep with separated feet, no crossed legs or bent torso.
